title: Tag input
summary: Free-text tags typed into one control: Enter or a separator adds, paste splits, Backspace in an empty field removes the last, duplicates and a maximum are handled.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint shown in the empty field.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

props.name: description
props.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

props.name: required
props.description: The form cannot be submitted while the value is empty.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext).

props.name: separators
props.description: Characters that end a tag (besides Enter).

props.name: max
props.description: Most tags allowed; 0 means no limit.

props.name: allowDuplicates
props.description: Allows the same tag twice (case-insensitive by default).

events.name: input
events.description: The value changed (native, composed: bubbles out of the shadow root). Read event.target.value.

events.name: change
events.description: The user committed the value (re-dispatched from the inner control, composed).

events.name: pk-tags-change
events.description: A tag was added or removed.

parts.name: box
parts.description: The bordered field holding tags and the text field.

a11y: Each remove button has an aria-label ("Remove dc") and is out of the tab order (Backspace is the keyboard route); adds and removes are announced through a polite status element; a form receives one entry per tag.

examples.title: Tags
examples.html: <pk-tag-input label="Tags" value="dc,variant" max="8" placeholder="add a tag"></pk-tag-input>
